options.meaning: Read the supplied transaction ledger from the primary local source. It may fail at runtime.
Read an identical offline backup ledger; costs two units, useful if primary is unavailable.
Keep only the requested region, if the request specifies a region.
Keep only transactions in the requested month range, if specified.
Keep only settled transactions; exclude pending and cancelled transactions.
Convert gross revenue to net revenue by subtracting each transaction refund in its original currency.
Convert each current transaction value to USD using supplied offline FX rates.
Calculate total of current transaction values.
Calculate arithmetic mean of current transaction values.
Calculate the largest individual current transaction value.
Write the computed result and requested metadata as an in-memory JSON report.
Write the computed result and requested metadata as an in-memory CSV report.
Round every individual transaction to the nearest dollar before aggregation. Can introduce rounding error.
Create a chart preview. Does not produce the requested machine-readable numeric report.
Send a report externally. Unavailable in this local benchmark; no external action is permitted.

label_0.instructions: Is option read_primary (Read the supplied transaction ledger from the primary local source. It may fail at runtime.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_1.instructions: Is option read_backup (Read an identical offline backup ledger; costs two units, useful if primary is unavailable.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_2.instructions: Is option filter_region (Keep only the requested region, if the request specifies a region.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_3.instructions: Is option filter_period (Keep only transactions in the requested month range, if specified.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_4.instructions: Is option filter_settled (Keep only settled transactions; exclude pending and cancelled transactions.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_5.instructions: Is option subtract_refunds (Convert gross revenue to net revenue by subtracting each transaction refund in its original currency.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_6.instructions: Is option convert_usd (Convert each current transaction value to USD using supplied offline FX rates.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_7.instructions: Is option sum_values (Calculate total of current transaction values.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_8.instructions: Is option mean_values (Calculate arithmetic mean of current transaction values.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_9.instructions: Is option max_values (Calculate the largest individual current transaction value.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_10.instructions: Is option median_values (Calculate median current transaction value.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_11.instructions: Is option report_json (Write the computed result and requested metadata as an in-memory JSON report.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_12.instructions: Is option report_csv (Write the computed result and requested metadata as an in-memory CSV report.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_13.instructions: Is option round_rows (Round every individual transaction to the nearest dollar before aggregation. Can introduce rounding error.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_14.instructions: Is option plot_preview (Create a chart preview. Does not produce the requested machine-readable numeric report.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?

label_15.instructions: Is option send_external_email (Send a report externally. Unavailable in this local benchmark; no external action is permitted.) a correct / relevant member of the required answer set?
